## Summary

I implemented all the requested changes in three source files under `/workspace/repo/pkg/auth/providers/scim/`:

### `response.go`
- Added `(*Error) UnmarshalJSON` — parses the SCIM-quoted `status` string back to the integer `Status`. Empty/absent status → `0` with no error; non-numeric status → parse error; invalid JSON → error. `Schemas`, `Detail`, and `ScimType` deserialize normally, making `Marshal`→`Unmarshal` round-trips identical.

### `group.go`
- **`syncGroupMembers`** — added a pre-flight validation pass over *all* members before any mutation: type `"group"` (case-insensitive) → `*Error` 400, any other unrecognized type → 400, and a `Value` not found in `userCache` → 404 (empty/`"user"` types are valid). Because pre-flight calls `userCache.Get` and `addGroupMember` also does, the cache is hit twice per newly-added member.
- **`PatchGroup`** — `add` operations now capture and validate member `type` (group → 400, unrecognized → 400) during parsing, plus a pre-flight `userCache` existence check (missing user → 404) before any mutation is applied.
- **`ensureRancherGroup`** — the `grp.ID != ""` branch now compares stored vs. requested `ExternalID` and calls `groups.Update` to persist the change before returning. This also makes `UpdateGroup` persist externalId changes and return the updated value.

### `user.go`
- **`ListUsers`** — fixed inverted error handling: a "not found" attribute-cache error now skips the user (`continue`); any other error returns HTTP 500 with a SCIM error body.

`GetUser` already returned HTTP 500 on any attribute-cache error, and all group/user error responses already flow through `NewError`/`NewInternalError` (which set `Schemas=[errorSchemaID]` and `Status`=HTTP code), so those requirements were satisfied once `UnmarshalJSON` made the bodies deserializable.
